    Given the rwb-access authorise fake refuses right U in Treatment and offer for the role

    Given the rwb-decision rule-set fake returns a settlement route set with no floor
    When the case owner prepares the route decision
    Then the calculation holds as UNMATCHED_EXCEPTION, names the missing value and raises a task for the case owner

    Then the operation returns 422 with MSG-GEN-001 naming the field and the transaction never opens

    Given the rwb-source-data account and balance fake gives no answer beyond 2 s
    When the case owner prepares the route decision
    Then the operation returns 503 with the platform problem body and nothing is written
